title: A label-only item revision must not invalidate a pending registered verification record
outcome: A label-only item revision must not invalidate a pending registered verification record
acceptance: A registered verification record whose delivery was deferred is accepted when the only change to the item since registration is a label or other non-acceptance planning edit; it is still refused when acceptance, claim, fence, run or named root changed

A behaviour test registers a run, applies a label-only update, then submits the record and observes it acknowledged; a second test changes acceptance and observes verification_record_refused naming work_revision
